import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
data = {
    "date": ["2024-01-01"] * 5,
    "time": ["00:00", "02:00", "04:00", "06:00", "08:00"],
    "product": ["Cappuccino", "Cappuccino", "Tea", "Latte", "Americano"],
    "size": ["Large", "Medium", "Small", "Large", "Medium"],
    "price": [4.18, 4.01, 5.22, 6.37, 7.07],
    "quantity": [2, 3, 1, 2, 3],
    "payment_method": ["Credit Card", "Credit Card", "Credit Card", "Credit Card", "Cash"],
    "customer_age_group": ["55+", "35-44", "18-24", "45-54", "45-54"],
    "is_takeaway": [1, 1, 1, 1, 1],
    "total": [8.36, 12.03, 5.22, 12.74, 21.21]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Create a bar plot
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.barplot(data=df, x='time', y='total', hue='product', palette='viridis')

# Adding titles and labels
plt.title('Total Sales by Time of Day and Product', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Time of Day', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=12)
plt.legend(title='Product', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')
